create_s3_import_storage: create an S3 import storage model for reading data from an AWS S3 bucket
create_azure_blob_storage: create an Azure Blob import or export storage model for reading from or writing to Azure Blob storage
create_gcs_storage: create a GCS import or export storage model for reading from or writing to Google Cloud Storage
create_redis_storage: create a Redis import or export storage model for reading from or writing to a Redis backend
get_storage_classes: get all registered storage model classes from Django settings for a given import or export type
